research:
Lines: NBC DFW HOU -8.5, o/u 229.5; Fox Sports HOU -8.5; Bleacher Nation 230.5 (picks HOU -8.5 and Under 230.5); World Today Journal ML HOU ~1.26-1.27 dec (~-380) / DAL 3.80-3.95, total 229.5-230.5. No US-odds spread or total prices were found.
Injuries: DAL out Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Caleb Martin (thumb), Tarik Biberovic (heel); Jett Howard questionable (calf); Max Christie returns. HOU: VanVleet back from injury; Julian Phillips (illness) and Steven Adams (calf) questionable; Durant was probable earlier (ankle, RotoWire).
DAL: new coach Dusty May. Kyrie Irving plays his first regular-season game since March 2025 (ACL), alongside reigning ROY Cooper Flagg (21.0/6.7/4.5 in 70 games). In preseason vs HOU: a 132-115 win, Kyrie 17 pts in 22 min; Flagg 33/10/10 over two games.
HOU: Ime Udoka's team returns healthy with VanVleet, Durant, Sengun, Amen Thompson. 2025-26 HOU 52-30 (NBAstuffer pace 96.2, 118.6/113.3); DAL 26-56.
Usage (2025-26): Durant 27.4% (Screwball, 26.0/5.4/4.6, 78 g); Sengun usage not found (20.4/8.9/6.2, 72 g, All-Star); Flagg and Kyrie miss the DvP gate anyway.

Totals (USU MACFAX adj.): DAL 109.3/115.8 pace 105.2; HOU 115.2/112.6 pace 100.4; avg poss 102.8. HOU 118.7 + DAL 114.1 = 232.8 vs 229.5-230.5 (+2.3 to +3.3), below the 4-pt trigger, so the total is not a leg.
Caveats: Kyrie's return should lift DAL's offense above last season's 109.3; Houston's slow half-court pace in 2025-26 (96.2 raw) pulls the other way. Bleacher Nation leans under.
Margin: model HOU +4.6 plus ~2 home court = ~6.6 vs 8.5, a small lean to DAL +8.5, offset by Dallas's thin frontcourt (Lively, Aldama out).
